_comment: THE QUOTE AGENT CONTRACT — takes the 5 intake fields, generates a price range, speaks it to the caller. Does nothing else.
_trust_tier_note: Tier 2 = GENERATE ONLY. Can read files and call LLM APIs. Cannot write to any database or external service. Zero side effects.
one_job: Take the 5 fields from the planner output. Look up the price range in hvac-pricing/SKILL.md. Generate a quote. Write it to state/artifacts/. Do not book anything.

quote_file._comment: within_skill_range must be true. If the generated price falls outside the ranges in hvac-pricing/SKILL.md the quote fails validation and must regenerate.

completion_condition.description: Quote file exists, all fields present, price_low is less than price_high, within_skill_range is true, quote_spoken_text is a complete sentence the voice agent can read aloud.
completion_condition.verifiable_check: file exists AND JSON parses AND price_low < price_high AND within_skill_range === true AND quote_spoken_text length > 20 characters
completion_condition.who_checks_this: evaluator — never the quote agent itself

allowed._comment: read_file is restricted to harness/skills/hvac-pricing/SKILL.md only

pricing_rules._comment: All price ranges live in harness/skills/hvac-pricing/SKILL.md. The quote agent reads that file. It never invents prices.

surcharges.urgency_emergency: add 25% to both low and high
surcharges.property_commercial: add 20% to both low and high
surcharges.both_apply: apply emergency surcharge first, then commercial

pricing_rules.format: Always spoken as a range. Never a single number. Example: 'Based on what you described, a typical AC refrigerant recharge runs between $150 and $300.'

must_include: a reference to what the caller described
quote_spoken_text_rules.tone_emergency: calm and direct — no excitement markers
quote_spoken_text_rules.tone_standard: warm and helpful — match the bubbly default voice

level_1_recoverable.trigger: within_skill_range is false OR quote_spoken_text fails validation
level_1_recoverable.action: regenerate once — log which field failed to state/traces/
level_1_recoverable.never_do: do not adjust the skill ranges to make the quote pass — the ranges are correct, the generation was wrong

level_2_unrecoverable.trigger: 3 attempts failed OR plan file missing required fields

what_this_agent_never_does: Never invents a price not in hvac-pricing/SKILL.md
Never quotes a single fixed price — always a range
Never proceeds if any of the 5 intake fields are missing from the plan file
Never reads any file except hvac-pricing/SKILL.md and the plan file

assumption_log.assumption: Claude Haiku can reliably generate quote spoken text that passes all validation rules without a dedicated fine-tuned model
assumption_log.expiry_test: Run 100 quotes, measure validation pass rate on first attempt. Target: 97%+
assumption_log.kill_threshold: If pass rate >= 99% — consider removing the regeneration retry to reduce latency
